messages:
Raj (PM): quick thread to capture proposal for a Q4 pilot: routing policies + multi-tenant isolation. want tradeoffs, launch checklist, and owners.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): need clarity: default policy for free/onboard tenants? latency-first or cost-first. customers ask for p95 guarantees.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): recommend latency-first default for PLG to avoid bad first impressions. offer opt-in cost-aware and residency policies. suggest 3 base profiles: latency, cost, residency.
Evan (Eng-ML): add model-aware fallback rule: prefer compatible quantized variant in-place before cross-region fallback to avoid large p50 regressions.
Lisa (Solutions): capture two customer asks: finance wants per-route cost caps + alerting; compliance customers need strict region pin + audit trail.
Raj (PM): agreed. need tiny policy DSL for pilot. Marie, can you draft minimal DSL surface?
Marie (Eng-Architecture): sketch:
```
- match: tenant.tier == "gold" -> route: latency_prefer
- match: tenant.residency == "eu" -> route: region_pin(eu-west-1)
- fallback: quantized_variant_then_region_fallback
```
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): add SLO guardrails: latency_prefer must aim for p95 < 250ms; if breached, queue + backpressure or controlled fallback. who owns verification?
Evan (Eng-ML): runtime can emit per-model+route p95 metrics. new behavior: auto-fallback to lower-cost route after sustained breach (>2m) if route is non-critical. critical routes (gold/compliance) should not auto-evacuate.
Lisa (Solutions): customer launch criteria: 1) documented policy precedence, 2) routing decision audit logs, 3) residency guarantees for pinned tenants, 4) cost caps + alerting.
Raj (PM): propose minimal pilot checklist:
- Route DSL v0 implemented (match + route + fallback)
- Per-route SLO metrics + dashboards
- Canary rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
- Migration playbook for pinned tenants
- Console routing preview + docs
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): infra callouts: cross-region KV invalidation for prefix/KV cache and KV warmup for model KV. these are blockers for low-latency cross-region failover. need infra spike (2 sprints).
Marie (Eng-Architecture): also call out egress cost tradeoff: routing to another region may improve latency but increase egress cost—document in decision log.
Evan (Eng-ML): also: model variant compatibility matrix needed. fallback should consult compatibility to avoid semantic regressions.
Lisa (Solutions): feature ask: expose "routing preview" in console so customers can input tenant attributes and see expected route. reduces support tickets.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): doable as a read-only evaluation endpoint + console. low-risk add-on.
Raj (PM): suggested ownership: DSL & precedence -> Marie; SLOs/dashboards -> Sanjay; model compatibility -> Evan; docs + preview -> Lisa; rollout ops/playbook -> Raj + oncall.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): isolation modes proposal: logical isolation (shared infra + soft limits), affinity isolation (sticky routing + pre-warmed pools), dedicated tenant pools (reserved capacity). default to logical; allow upgrade paths.
Lisa (Solutions): compliance customers will pick dedicated pools. ensure pricing and SLA language ready.
Evan (Eng-ML): for affinity isolation, ensure cache warmup/topology pre-seeding to avoid cold-start tails—add to playbook.
infra-bot: deploy-ci: routing-dsl/v0 build #2044 passed (sha: def456) :white_check_mark:
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): rough sprint estimate: infra spike (2 sprints), DSL parser+evaluator (1 sprint), metrics plumbing (1 sprint) -> ~4 sprints to pilot.
Raj (PM): timeline check: target pilot end of Oct works with current velocity.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): risks: model catalog lag for compatibility, and mixed-residency requests. mitigation: block automatic cross-region fallback when residency flag present.
Lisa (Solutions): onboarding checkbox idea: "allow cross-region fallback" so sales can negotiate and toggle.
Evan (Eng-ML): good—also add explicit error path if cross-region blocked so caller sees a clear status instead of silent fallback.
Raj (PM): action items: Marie to PR DSL spec; Sanjay to schedule infra spike; Evan to start compatibility matrix; Lisa to draft docs + onboarding checkbox; Raj to draft rollout playbook. I'll write a short decisions doc by EOD Friday.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): tagging owners on project board.
Marie (Eng-Architecture): posted a short RFC draft to arch folder; will paste link here when live.
Lisa (Solutions): thanks. reconvene Tue 10am PT for decision review?
Raj (PM): yep, invite sent. :calendar:
